name: @pipeworx/mcp-nbu-ua

tools.name: nbu_exchange_rates
tools.description: Official NBU exchange rates for ALL currencies on a single day (the rate the National Bank of Ukraine sets daily). Returns one record per currency: {r030 (numeric currency code), txt (Ukrainian name), rate (UAH per 1 unit of the currency), cc (ISO-4217 code, e.g. USD/EUR/PLN), exchangedate (DD.MM.YYYY)}. Omit `date` for today's rates.

date.description: Day to fetch, format YYYYMMDD, e.g. "20240115". Omit for the latest/today.

tools.name: nbu_currency_rate
tools.description: Official NBU rate for a SINGLE currency on one day. Pass `valcode` as an ISO-4217 code (e.g. USD, EUR, GBP). `rate` is UAH per 1 unit of that currency. Omit `date` for today. For a time series of one currency across a date range, use `nbu_currency_history` instead.

date.description: Day to fetch, format YYYYMMDD, e.g. "20240115". Omit for the latest/today.

tools.name: nbu_currency_history
tools.description: Daily time series of the official NBU rate for ONE currency over a date range. Pass `valcode` (ISO-4217, e.g. USD) and `start`/`end` as YYYYMMDD. Returns one record per business day: {exchangedate (DD.MM.YYYY), cc, txt (Ukrainian name), enname (English name), rate (UAH per `units`), units, rate_per_unit}. Omit `valcode` to get every currency over the range. Newest first.

valcode.description: ISO-4217 currency code, e.g. "USD". Omit to return all currencies.

tools.name: nbu_monetary_aggregates
tools.description: NBU monetary aggregates (M0, M1, M2, M3 money supply, in UAH million) for a given month. Each record: {dt (YYYYMMDD), txt (Ukrainian name), txten (English name), id_api (e.g. M2/M3), value, freq}. `date` selects the reference month (any day in it); omit for the latest available month.

date.description: Reference day inside the month, YYYYMMDD, e.g. "20240101". Omit for latest.

tools.name: nbu_international_reserves
tools.description: NBU official international (reserve) assets for a given month, broken down by component. Each record: {dt (YYYYMMDD), txt (Ukrainian name), txten (English name), id_api, value, freq}. `date` selects the reference month; omit for the latest available month.

date.description: Reference day inside the month, YYYYMMDD, e.g. "20240101". Omit for latest.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-nbu-ua forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the nbu-ua pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
